King's Recruit#001.src: {#}Cast your Arrow Bomb Spell by clicking  LEFT -  RIGHT -  RIGHT  while holding your Bow

similar.text: {#}Cast your Arrow Storm Spell by clicking  RIGHT -  LEFT -  RIGHT  while holding your Bow

King's Recruit#002.src: You three are going to make fine soldiers. Now, go on to {p}, the King is awaiting your arrival.

King's Recruit#003.src: Well, what are we waiting for?

King's Recruit#006.src: Hey, {u}! You alright in there? Looks like we hit something.
King's Recruit#006.dst: 이봐, {u}! 안에 괜찮아? 뭔가에 부딪힌 것 같아.

King's Recruit#007.src: Exit the caravan and talk to the Caravan Driver at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

King's Recruit#008.src: Hm... I swear I hit this same darn boulder every time I make this trip. Sorry folks.
King's Recruit#008.dst: 흠... 이 길 올 때마다 꼭 이 빌어먹을 바위에 부딪힌단 말이지. 미안하오, 여러분.
King's Recruit#008.speaker: Caravan Driver

King's Recruit#009.src: Ah. Does this mean we have to walk all the way to {p} from here?
King's Recruit#009.dst: 아. 그럼 여기서부터 {p}까지 걸어가야 한다는 거야?
King's Recruit#009.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#010.src: Unfortunately so. Luckily, it's not that far from here. Just a straight path forward.
King's Recruit#010.dst: 안타깝지만 그렇소. 다행히 여기서 멀지 않소. 쭉 앞으로만 가면 되오.
King's Recruit#010.speaker: Caravan Driver

King's Recruit#011.src: Well, nothing to do but keep moving! Tasim, {u}, I'll race you to the gate!
King's Recruit#011.dst: 뭐, 계속 가는 수밖에! Tasim, {u}, 관문까지 누가 먼저 가나 시합이야!
King's Recruit#011.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#013.src: ... He's already gone. We'll have to catch up to him. {u}, lead the way.
King's Recruit#013.dst: ... 벌써 가 버렸네. 따라잡아야겠어. {u}, 앞장서 줘.
King's Recruit#013.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#014.src: Walk down the path towards the gate to the Wynn Province at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
King's Recruit#014.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]의 Wynn 지방 관문을 향해 길을 따라가세요.

King's Recruit#015.src: I don't suppose you know much about Wynn either, do you?
King's Recruit#015.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#016.src: Of course, the King of {p}'s been recruiting Fruma soldiers, but...
King's Recruit#016.dst: 물론 {p}의 왕이 Fruma 병사를 모집해 왔지만...
King's Recruit#016.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#017.src: That war of theirs must be getting pretty bad if they need this much support.
King's Recruit#017.dst: 이만큼 지원이 필요하다면 그 전쟁이 꽤 심각한가 봐.
King's Recruit#017.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#018.src: Oh, there's Aledar! And the gate, by the looks of it.
King's Recruit#018.dst: 아, Aledar가 저기 있네! 보아하니 관문도 있고.
King's Recruit#018.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#019.src: There you two are! You'll have to be faster than that if you want to stand a chance against the undead.
King's Recruit#019.dst: 드디어 왔네! 언데드를 상대하려면 그것보단 빨라야 할걸.
King's Recruit#019.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#020.src: Yes, yes, we'll be faster next time. So, is this the gate marking the border between Wynn and Fruma?
King's Recruit#020.dst: 그래, 그래, 다음엔 빨리 올게. 그래서, 이게 Wynn과 Fruma의 경계 관문이야?
King's Recruit#020.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#021.src: It looks like it, yep! Are you two ready for the start of our new lives?
King's Recruit#021.dst: 그런 것 같아! 둘 다 새 삶을 시작할 준비 됐어?
King's Recruit#021.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#022.src: {u}, why don't you do the honours? Go ahead and open that gate.
King's Recruit#022.dst: {u}, 영광은 네가 누려. 어서 저 관문을 열어 봐.
King's Recruit#022.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#023.src: Enter the Province of Wynn at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

King's Recruit#024.src: Well, what are we waiting for? Let's go ahead and explore this province.
King's Recruit#024.dst: 자, 뭘 기다려? 이 지방을 한번 둘러보자.
King's Recruit#024.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#025.src: Continue through the Wynn Province to the castle
King's Recruit#025.dst: Wynn 지방을 지나 성으로 계속 가세요

King's Recruit#026.src: So this is Wynn we've all been hearing about... It's beautiful.
King's Recruit#026.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#027.src: I guess the war hasn't made it this far. This is what we'll be fighting to protect.
King's Recruit#027.dst: 전쟁이 여기까진 안 왔나 봐. 우리가 싸워서 지킬 곳이 바로 이거야.
King's Recruit#027.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#028.src: Hey, recruits! Come over here, I have something to tell you.
King's Recruit#028.dst: 이봐, 신병들! 이리 와, 할 말이 있다.
King's Recruit#028.speaker: Soldier

King's Recruit#030.src: A soldier? What are you doing all the way out here?
King's Recruit#030.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#031.src: There's a bit of trouble up ahead. They sent me out here to intercept new recruits.
King's Recruit#031.dst: 앞쪽에 문제가 좀 생겼다. 새 신병들을 붙잡으라고 날 여기 보냈지.
King's Recruit#031.speaker: Soldier

King's Recruit#032.src: If you want to survive out here, you're going to need this.
King's Recruit#032.speaker: Soldier

King's Recruit#035.src: Hopefully we won't have to use these just yet.
King's Recruit#035.dst: 당분간은 이걸 쓸 일이 없으면 좋겠네.
King's Recruit#035.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#036.src: Good luck out there, recruits! Just follow this path, and there will be a bridge up ahead.
King's Recruit#036.dst: 조심해라, 신병들! 이 길을 따라가면 앞에 다리가 나올 거다.
King's Recruit#036.speaker: Soldier

King's Recruit#038.src: Ah, this must be the bridge the soldier was talking about. But it certainly looks very...
King's Recruit#038.dst: 아, 이게 그 병사가 말한 다리인가 봐. 그런데 확실히 좀...
King's Recruit#038.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#039.src: Well, let's not keep the King of {p} waiting!
King's Recruit#039.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#043.src: That's what I was trying to warn you about! Let's just get off this bridge before the rest of it collapses...
King's Recruit#043.dst: 내가 경고하려던 게 그거였어! 나머지가 무너지기 전에 다리에서 내려가자...
King's Recruit#043.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#044.src: Well, how are we meant to get to the other side of this ravine now? Ugh. Another thing gone wrong, just like-...
King's Recruit#044.dst: 그럼 이 협곡을 이제 어떻게 건너지? 으. 또 일이 꼬였네, 꼭 그때처럼-...
King's Recruit#044.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#046.src: That's... weird. I was just thinking about something from before Wynn, but... it's gone. I can't remember.
King's Recruit#046.dst: 그게... 이상해. Wynn에 오기 전 일을 떠올리고 있었는데... 사라졌어. 기억이 안 나.
King's Recruit#046.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#047.src: Hm. I can't remember anything from Fruma either... {u}, how about you?
King's Recruit#047.dst: 흠. 나도 Fruma 일이 하나도 기억 안 나... {u}, 너는?
King's Recruit#047.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#048.src: Nothing. It can't be a coincidence we all lost our memories at the same time, right?
King's Recruit#048.dst: 아무것도. 다 같이 동시에 기억을 잃은 게 우연일 리 없잖아, 그렇지?
King's Recruit#048.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#049.src: No, but... We can worry about that later. For now, we need to find a way past this ravine. Aledar, {u}, you should look around for a way across. I'll keep looking here.
King's Recruit#049.dst: 그렇지, 하지만... 그건 나중에 걱정하자. 지금은 협곡을 건널 방법부터 찾아야 해. Aledar, {u}, 둘이 건널 길을 찾아봐. 난 여기서 계속 볼게.
King's Recruit#049.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#051.src: Search for another way across the ravine at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

King's Recruit#052.src: Woah! That sure did the trick, {u}. Good thinking!
King's Recruit#052.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#053.src: Hey, Tasim! Come over here, {u} found a way over!
King's Recruit#053.dst: 어이, Tasim! 이리 와, {u}이(가) 건널 길을 찾았어!
King's Recruit#053.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#055.src: Phew! We made it over safely this time at least.
King's Recruit#055.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#056.src: If we just continue forward, we should make it to {p} in no time!
King's Recruit#056.dst: 이대로 쭉 가면 금방 {p}에 도착할 거야!
King's Recruit#056.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#057.src: Hmm? What's that guard doing here? We should probably talk to them if we want to pass through.
King's Recruit#057.dst: 응? 저 경비병은 여기서 뭐 하지? 지나가려면 얘기해 봐야겠어.
King's Recruit#057.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#061.src: A group of corrupted have sieged this underpass. I can't let you enter without any armour.
King's Recruit#061.dst: 타락한 것들 무리가 이 지하 통로를 점거했다. 방어구 없이는 들여보낼 수 없다.
King's Recruit#061.speaker: Guard

King's Recruit#062.src: Then what do we do? We have to get to {p}!
King's Recruit#062.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#063.src: Do you see that cave over there? Caves such as those often contain useful loot that can help keep you alive.
King's Recruit#063.dst: 저기 동굴 보이나? 그런 동굴엔 목숨을 지켜 줄 쓸 만한 전리품이 있곤 하지.
King's Recruit#063.speaker: Guard

King's Recruit#064.src: If you enter the cave, you should be able to find some armour to protect you. After that return to me.
King's Recruit#064.dst: 동굴에 들어가면 몸을 지킬 방어구를 찾을 수 있을 거다. 그다음 내게 돌아와라.
King's Recruit#064.speaker: Guard

King's Recruit#065.src: What do you say {u}? Let's go see what's in that cave.
King's Recruit#065.dst: 어때, {u}? 저 동굴에 뭐가 있는지 가 보자.
King's Recruit#065.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#066.src: Enter the cave and find some armour at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

King's Recruit#067.src: We should return to the guard to see if he'll let us through now!
King's Recruit#067.dst: 경비병한테 돌아가서 이제 지나가게 해 줄지 보자!
King's Recruit#067.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#069.src: So you found some armor, huh?
King's Recruit#069.speaker: Guard

King's Recruit#070.src: Yes, a helmet! Will you let us pass now?
King's Recruit#070.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#071.src: Hold on there, recruit. Before you can equip a piece of armor you first have to identify it.
King's Recruit#071.dst: 잠깐, 신병. 방어구를 장착하려면 먼저 감정부터 해야 한다.
King's Recruit#071.speaker: Guard

King's Recruit#072.src: And how do we do that?
King's Recruit#072.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#073.src: You can identify items at Item Identifiers. They exist in every city across the whole world, and we keep one here for convenience.
King's Recruit#073.dst: 아이템은 Item Identifier에게서 감정할 수 있다. 세상 모든 도시에 있고, 편의를 위해 여기도 한 명 두고 있지.
King's Recruit#073.speaker: Guard

King's Recruit#074.src: Identify your helmet at the Item Identifier and then return to me with it equipped. After you've done that I'll let you pass.
King's Recruit#074.dst: Item Identifier에게 투구를 감정받고 장착한 채로 돌아와라. 그러면 지나가게 해 주지.
King's Recruit#074.speaker: Guard

King's Recruit#076.src: I see you have your helmet on. Fantastic, you may now pass. Let me open this door for you.
King's Recruit#076.dst: 투구를 썼군. 훌륭하다, 이제 지나가도 좋다. 문을 열어 주지.
King's Recruit#076.speaker: Guard

King's Recruit#077.src: Good luck in there recruits! Even with your armour it won't be so easy!
King's Recruit#077.dst: 안에서 행운을 빈다, 신병들! 방어구가 있어도 쉽지 않을 거다!
King's Recruit#077.speaker: Guard

King's Recruit#080.src: Wow, that guard wasn't joking. This place is crawling with the corrupt.
King's Recruit#080.dst: 와, 경비병 말이 농담이 아니었네. 여긴 타락한 것들이 득실거려.
King's Recruit#080.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#081.src: Well, we've got no choice but to make it through! Finally time for us to use these weapons we got. Let's go, {u}.
King's Recruit#081.dst: 뭐, 뚫고 가는 수밖에! 드디어 받은 무기를 써 볼 때야. 가자, {u}.
King's Recruit#081.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#082.src: {u}, you take the skeleton in the front. We'll handle the two zombies in the back!
King's Recruit#082.dst: {u}, 앞에 있는 스켈레톤을 맡아. 뒤에 좀비 둘은 우리가 처리할게!
King's Recruit#082.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#085.src: This path opened up, let's continue through the underpass.
King's Recruit#085.dst: 길이 열렸어. 지하 통로를 계속 지나가자.
King's Recruit#085.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#087.src: Over here! You're just what I needed!
King's Recruit#087.speaker: Lieutenant

King's Recruit#089.src: Finally, some backup! Wait a second... you're straight from Fruma aren't you?
King's Recruit#089.dst: 드디어 지원군이군! 잠깐... 너희 Fruma에서 막 온 거지?
King's Recruit#089.speaker: Lieutenant

King's Recruit#090.src: Oh well, this area should be clear by now. {p} is just up ahead, after all.
King's Recruit#090.dst: 뭐, 이 구역은 이제 정리됐을 거다. {p}도 바로 앞이니까.
King's Recruit#090.speaker: Lieutenant

King's Recruit#092.src: Quick, you have to use an ability!
King's Recruit#092.speaker: Lieutenant

King's Recruit#094.src: Wait, it's running away! We have to save the Lieutenant!
King's Recruit#094.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#096.src: Defeat the Goliath and free the Lieutenant.

King's Recruit#097.src: That sure was close... Thanks for the save, {u}!
King's Recruit#097.speaker: Lieutenant

King's Recruit#098.src: I think you three are going to make good soldiers - not many can handle themselves like you just did.
King's Recruit#098.dst: 너희 셋은 좋은 병사가 되겠어. 방금처럼 해내는 사람은 드물지.
King's Recruit#098.speaker: Lieutenant

King's Recruit#099.src: It seems that beast dropped something, you should check it out before heading to {p}.
King's Recruit#099.dst: 그 짐승이 뭔가 떨어뜨린 것 같다. {p}에 가기 전에 확인해 봐라.
King's Recruit#099.speaker: Lieutenant

King's Recruit#100.src: Pick up the loot dropped by the Goliath.

King's Recruit#101.src: That item looks rare! Maybe there's an identifier around here.
King's Recruit#101.dst: 희귀한 아이템 같아! 근처에 감정사가 있을지도.
King's Recruit#101.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#104.src: We... we made it! We really made it! Sure was a close call at the end.
King's Recruit#104.dst: 우리... 도착했어! 진짜 해냈어! 마지막엔 정말 아슬아슬했지만.
King's Recruit#104.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#105.src: ... Still think those corrupted don't stand a chance against you?
King's Recruit#105.dst: ... 아직도 타락한 것들이 너한텐 상대도 안 된다고 생각해?
King's Recruit#105.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#106.src: Ha ha. Very funny. Ah, {u}, there seems to be an identifier here for you to identify that rare helmet.
King's Recruit#106.dst: 하하. 퍽이나 웃기네. 아, {u}, 여기 감정사가 있으니 그 희귀한 투구를 감정받아.
King's Recruit#106.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#107.src: And a blacksmith too, you can sell your old helmet there for some emeralds.
King's Recruit#107.dst: 대장장이도 있네. 쓰던 투구는 거기 팔아서 에메랄드로 바꿔.
King's Recruit#107.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#108.src: Here it is, the end of our journey.
King's Recruit#108.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#109.src: The end of one adventure, but the beginning of another! Let's go inside and talk to the King!
King's Recruit#109.dst: 한 모험의 끝이자 또 다른 모험의 시작이지! 들어가서 왕과 얘기하자!
King's Recruit#109.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#111.src: Welcome to the Province of Wynn! By your ragged appearance, I gather your journey here must have been quite the adventure.
King's Recruit#111.dst: Wynn 지방에 온 것을 환영한다! 행색을 보아하니 오는 길이 꽤나 험난했던 모양이군.
King's Recruit#111.speaker: King of Ragni

King's Recruit#112.src: This, recruits, is the noble fort of {p}, one of the great cities of our province!
King's Recruit#112.dst: 신병들이여, 이곳은 우리 지방의 대도시 중 하나, 고귀한 요새 {p}이다!
King's Recruit#112.speaker: King of Ragni

King's Recruit#113.src: As soldiers of Wynn, it is your duty to stem the tide of corrupted monsters ravaging this land.
King's Recruit#113.dst: Wynn의 병사로서 이 땅을 유린하는 타락한 괴물의 물결을 막는 것이 그대들의 의무다.
King's Recruit#113.speaker: King of Ragni

King's Recruit#114.src: Although, you may want to gain some experience beforehand. Many lives are tragically lost every day...
King's Recruit#114.dst: 허나 그 전에 경험을 좀 쌓는 게 좋을 게다. 매일 수많은 목숨이 안타깝게 스러지니...
King's Recruit#114.speaker: King of Ragni

King's Recruit#115.src: Take this [{p} Teleportation Scroll] to aid you in your journey. Upon use, it will instantly bring you back to this city, wherever you may be.
King's Recruit#115.dst: 여정에 도움이 되도록 이 [{p} Teleportation Scroll]을 가져가게. 사용하면 어디에 있든 즉시 이 도시로 돌아올 수 있다네.
King's Recruit#115.speaker: King of Ragni

King's Recruit#116.src: With that, I must bid you farewell, more recruits may arrive at any time. Good luck out there, soldiers of Wynn!
King's Recruit#116.dst: 이만 작별해야겠군. 신병이 언제 또 올지 모르니. 행운을 빈다, Wynn의 병사들이여!
King's Recruit#116.speaker: King of Ragni

King's Recruit#117.src: So! Wynn, huh? It's pretty exciting to finally be here.
King's Recruit#117.dst: 자! Wynn이라, 응? 드디어 여기 오니 꽤 설레네.
King's Recruit#117.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#118.src: I can't wait to discover what it looks like for myself!
King's Recruit#118.dst: 직접 어떤 곳인지 빨리 보고 싶어!
King's Recruit#118.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#119.src: Ha, well, I think I'm going to head in the direction of {p} soon, although there seems to be something called {p} on the way...
King's Recruit#119.dst: 하, 난 곧 {p} 쪽으로 갈 생각이야. 가는 길에 {p}(이)라는 곳이 있는 것 같지만...
King's Recruit#119.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#120.src: Enough talking already! Let's get out there and help some people!
King's Recruit#120.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#121.src: And he's gone again... Well, I'm sure we'll be seeing him soon enough. For now, let's just see what Wynn really is like.
King's Recruit#121.dst: 또 가 버렸네... 뭐, 금방 다시 만나겠지. 일단 Wynn이 진짜 어떤 곳인지 보자.
King's Recruit#121.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#122.src: It's beautiful... Oh! I almost forgot to tell you, {u}.
King's Recruit#122.dst: 아름답다... 아! 깜빡하고 말 안 할 뻔했네, {u}.
King's Recruit#122.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#123.src: There's this handy item we were all given on our way here, the Content Book. It displays most things you can do in this world; Quests, Caves, and much, much more.
King's Recruit#123.dst: 오는 길에 다들 받은 편리한 물건이 있잖아, 콘텐츠 북. 이 세계에서 할 수 있는 것 대부분을 보여 줘. 퀘스트, 동굴, 그리고 훨씬 더 많은 것들.
King's Recruit#123.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#124.src: It also lets you track any content you want, which will create beacons for you to follow.
King's Recruit#124.dst: 원하는 콘텐츠를 추적할 수도 있어. 그러면 따라갈 신호기가 생겨.
King's Recruit#124.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#125.src: Here, why don't you try it out? Use your Content Book, and click on the highlighted quest.
King's Recruit#125.dst: 자, 한번 써 볼래? 콘텐츠 북을 열고 강조된 퀘스트를 클릭해 봐.
King's Recruit#125.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#126.src: There you go! I'm going to head towards {p}, at the end of the {p}.
King's Recruit#126.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#127.src: You should meet me there once you've gotten a little stronger. Well, see you around, {u}.
King's Recruit#127.dst: 좀 더 강해지면 거기서 만나. 그럼 또 보자, {u}.
King's Recruit#127.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#128.src: What are you waiting for recruits? Go identify your helmet at the  Item Identifier and then equip it in your helmet slot!
King's Recruit#128.dst: 뭘 기다리나, 신병들? 어서  Item Identifier에게 투구를 감정받고 투구 칸에 장착해라!

King's Recruit#129.src: Unless you'd rather stand around here all day, that's fine by me too.
King's Recruit#129.dst: 여기 온종일 서 있고 싶다면야, 그것도 상관없다.

King's Recruit#130.src: Well, what are you waiting for?

King's Recruit#131.src: Good luck in there, recruits! You're gonna need it...
King's Recruit#131.dst: 안에서 행운을 빈다, 신병들! 필요할 거다...
King's Recruit#131.speaker: Guard
